text: １ぴきだけ　そだてても　つよい　トレーナーに　なれない　おおくの　ポケモンを　バランス　よく　そだてるのも　たいへん　だけどな

structure.en: even if you raise just one

structure.jp: つよい　トレーナーに　なれない
structure.en: you can't become a strong Trainer

structure.jp: おおくの　ポケモンを　バランス　よく　そだてるのも
structure.en: raising many Pokémon in a balanced way, too

structure.jp: たいへん　だけどな

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.explanation: も after a て-form verb means 'even if you do that'. そだてても = 'even if you raise it'.

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about. そだてるの = 'raising them'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど at the end of a sentence means 'though', softening what was just said. な adds a musing tone. たいへん だけどな = 'it's hard, though'.
